title: gDNA extraction from Sterivex filters
author: Sophie Jurgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ijccciw
materials: Plug the outflow port of Sterivex cartridge using cha-seal clay. Ensure that incubator is set to 65°C. Place rotator in the incubator. Cha-seal tube sealing compound Medline Catalog #CSX43510 Sterivex™ filter unit without filling bell Merck Millipore (EMD Millipore) Catalog #SVGP01050 Labquake™ Rotisserie Hybridization Rotator Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #M90615Q

steps.title: Add CTAB extraction solution
steps.instruction: Using a 3 mL BD syringe (catalog #BD 309586) fitted with a 22‑gauge needle (catalog #Z192473), slowly dispense CTAB extraction solution (Teknova catalog #C2190) into each Sterivex cartridge, avoiding air bubbles that could clog the port.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and Lysozyme
steps.instruction: Add 65 µL Proteinase K (10 mg mL⁻¹, Thermo Fisher catalog #EO0491) and 65 µL Lysozyme (10 mg mL⁻¹, Sigma‑Aldrich catalog #12671-19-1) to each cartridge with the same needle‑syringe; the two enzymes may be combined into a single 130 µL aliquot.

steps.title: Add SDS solution
steps.instruction: Add 162 µL filter‑sterilized 10 % SDS (Life Technologies catalog #AM9822) to each cartridge and invert gently to mix.

steps.title: Incubate cartridges
steps.instruction: Cap the open end of each cartridge with a luer‑lock cap and place on a rotary agitator set to 65 °C for 2 h (02:00:00).

steps.title: Label storage tubes
steps.instruction: Label two sets of 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes with the sample name; one set will be stored at –20 °C and the other set will be used for downstream extraction.

steps.title: Collect filtrate
steps.instruction: Attach a 3 mL luer‑lock syringe to the Sterivex cartridge, draw out the liquid, dispense 2 mL into the first labeled 2 mL tube (to be frozen), then pipette 800 µL of this material into a second labeled 2 mL tube for further extraction; place the 2 mL tube in a –20 °C freezer and start the microcentrifuge cool‑down at 4 °C.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 800 µL phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (PCI, 25:24:1, pH 8.0; Thermo Fisher catalog #15593031) to each tube and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Chloroform wash (first)
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (CI, 24:1; Sigma‑Aldrich catalog #C0549) to each tube, invert and vortex, then centrifuge at 15,000 rpm for 5 min; transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 mL tube, avoiding the interphase.

steps.title: Chloroform wash (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the chloroform:isoamyl alcohol addition and centrifugation as in the previous step; this time transfer the upper aqueous phase to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Final aqueous centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 10,000 rpm for 5 min; carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 mL tube, taking care not to aspirate the interphase and not to remove all of the aqueous layer.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 450 µL room‑temperature 100 % isopropanol to each tube, invert gently to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 2 h to overnight.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 20 min; carefully decant the supernatant into a clean petri dish (or aspirate with a pipette) and blot the tubes dry with a paper towel, taking care not to lose the pellet.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 1.4 mL 70 % ethanol to each tube, invert several times to mix, centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 5 min, then pour off the ethanol.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the tubes in a laminar flow hood for 10–15 min or until completely dry; avoid inverting the tubes as pellets may become dislodged.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL sterile nuclease‑free ultra‑pure water to each tube and pipet gently to dissolve the DNA; optionally pre‑heat the water to 50 °C or incubate at 37 °C for 1–2 h to aid dissolution.

steps.title: Quantify and store DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration and 260/280 ratio using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher catalog #ND-1000), record the values, and freeze the samples at –80 °C.
